image_description: A large, greyish-green common iguana (Iguana iguana) is perched on a rough, light-colored rock at the edge of a body of water. The iguana is facing left, displaying a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine and a visible dewlap under its chin. Its skin appears textured with granular scales. The background consists of green foliage on the left and murky green water on the right. The lighting suggests daylight, casting soft shadows.
